source_text:
given $\epsilon>0$, take $F\in\Sigma$ of finite
measure and $M\ge 0$ such that
$\int(|v|-M\chi F^{\ssbullet})^+\le\epsilon$.   Show that
$\|u-u'\|_1\le\epsilon+M\bar\rho_F(u,u')$ for all $u$, $u'\in A$.
target_text:
Jika diberikan $\epsilon>0$, ambil $F\in\Sigma$ berukuran berhingga dan
$M\ge 0$ sehingga $\int(|v|-M\chi F^{\ssbullet})^+\le\epsilon$. Tunjukkan
bahwa $\|u-u'\|_1\le\epsilon+M\bar\rho_F(u,u')$ untuk setiap $u$, $u'\in A$.

source_text:
use 215A to show that if $\mu E<\infty$ then
$\mu E=\sup\{\mu F:F\subseteq E,\,\nu F<\infty\}$.
target_text:
Gunakan 215A
untuk menunjukkan bahwa jika $\mu E<\infty$ maka $\mu E=\sup\{\mu F:F\subseteq
E,\,\nu F<\infty\}$.

source_text:
set
$\gamma=\inf_{u\in A}\bar\tau_F(u)$;  find a non-increasing sequence
$\sequencen{u_n}$ in $A$ such that
$\lim_{n\to\infty}\bar\tau_F(u_n)=\gamma$;  set $v=(\chi
F)^{\ssbullet}\wedge\inf_{n\in\Bbb N}u_n$ and show that $u\wedge v=v$
for every $u\in A$, so that $v=0$.
target_text:
Tetapkan $\gamma=\inf_{u\in
A}\bar\tau_F(u)$; temukan barisan menurun $\sequencen{u_n}$ dalam $A$
sehingga $\lim_{n\to\infty}\bar\tau_F(u_n)=\gamma$; tetapkan $v=(\chi
F)^{\ssbullet}\wedge\inf_{n\in\Bbb N}u_n$ dan tunjukkan bahwa $u\wedge v=v$
untuk setiap $u\in A$, sehingga $v=0$.
